impact: European tech is feeling Nvidia's leadership uncertainty, which matters for NOK, but broader risk appetite remains firm.
summary: The Stoxx 600 slipped 0.2% to 662.51 Friday morning after Thursday's record 666.58 intraday high, ending a four-day rally, with tech down 0.9%. The DAX fell 0.3% and the CAC 0.2%, while the FTSE 100 was flat. The index is still on track for a weekly gain of about 2.4%, its best since June, and Goldman Sachs raised its 12-month target to 700 from 695.
title: Europe dips from record: Stoxx 600 -0.2%, still set for best week since June
